question: Under the Factories Act 1948, a factory employing 500 or more workers is required to appoint a qualified Safety Officer.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is actually true. The Factories Act 1948, Section 40-B, requires appointment of a Safety Officer in factories employing 500 or more workers. The specific number is a common exam question.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Section 40-B of the Factories Act mandates a Safety Officer in factories with ≥ 500 workers. This is distinct from the Welfare Officer threshold (≥ 500 workers in some states) and the occupational health physician requirement.
